scope.feature: current-v19 Supplies positive-row acquisition and read-only state-detail acceptance

acceptanceHarness.positiveProofPolicy: A full 2500-block Treasure scan must publish at least one authentic Supplies row before read-only refresh/detail acceptance can pass.
acceptanceHarness.returnPolicy: Cross-server proof returns to the original server and revalidates live context before owned-session stop.

sourceFacts: SeasonSuppliesShareDataManager resolves Supplies activity from current-server season state.
WorldSuppliesPointData owns CheckBtnState/HasPlayer and detail parsing.
WorldGetSuppliesPointDetail remains the only network read used by the read-only Supplies state lane.
No claim/scout/march action is part of the acceptance harness.

authoritativeNegativeScan.reason: No authentic WorldSuppliesPoint was present in the full-world published population.

additionalAuthoritativeNegativeScan.reason: The strict positive Supplies gate rejected a second complete full-world population with zero WorldSuppliesPoint rows.

reachablePopulationDiscovery.method: temporary aggregate-only read-only season/activity metadata diagnostic; removed before checkpoint
reachablePopulationDiscovery.acceptanceAuthority: not acceptance evidence; used only to avoid blind full-world scans
reachablePopulationDiscovery.transientObservation: One server-2204 return attempt reported game connection unavailable; the same owned session recovered on the following iteration and final cleanup returned to server 2212. It is not treated as population evidence.

conclusion.reason: No active Supplies activity was found in the exhaustive 2149-2211 metadata sweep; home server 2212 was already Supplies-negative under R7-069, and strict full-world scans on reachable servers 2204 and 2213 both published zero Supplies rows.
conclusion.nextAction: Rerun the unchanged strict harness when SeasonSuppliesShareDataManager exposes an active Supplies activity or a full-world scan publishes pointType 27 WorldSuppliesPoint.

limits: No positive Supplies state/detail claim is made.
Servers rejected by the game's server_jump_precheck were not bypassed.
No claim, scout, march, attack, plunder, collection, messaging, alliance-share, or consumable action occurred.
privacy: Aggregate-only evidence. No player identity, UUID, coordinates, session/challenge identifiers, process identifiers, raw rows, databases, or raw diagnostic logs are retained.
